title: Kamishiro Rui — An Unexpected Find!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's odd. Where did that breadboard go? I thought I left it somewhere around here...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm...? I could've sworn this used to be on that shelf. And this was hanging from the ceiling...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm... That film did keep me very busy recently. As a result, this place has turned into a bit of a sty...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
In any case, I should try to tidy up...
That should make it easier to find the breadboard.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (If it weren't so late at night, I'd move everything out of my room and back in one by one...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For now, I'll just move the things I need off to the left and whatever I don't to the right...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Phew...
I've mostly divided everything up into a couple nice piles.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But despite all this cleaning and sorting, I still can't seem to find that breadboard...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Where did past me put it a few days ago?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, how nostalgic...!
This is the dog robot I tried to make all those years ago!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If I recall, I wasn't happy with the way his legs and tail moved. My plan was to rebuild his joints from scratch...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I had trouble acquiring the parts I wanted, which ended with me putting everything on hold.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The time has come for the bird robot I made for our shows to rise once more...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, it's up!
Time to catch you!!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The joints I used for Robo-Phoenix's wings might just be what Robo-Dog's legs and tail need.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Where did I put Robo-Phoenix's parts...?
I saw them just... Ah, here we are!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, also! If I want him to move like a real dog, I should make him look like one!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The right pile should have just what I need...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, this...!
I can put something I was going to throw out to good use! Two birds with one stone!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Excellent! Your legs are definitely moving much more smoothly compared to back then!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, please try to keep your voice down.
It is half past three in the morning.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I guess I'll just have to mute you...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (He looks and walks much more like a real dog now.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But aside from walking and barking, all he's really able to do is stand around...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I should try to give him more of a doglike charm by getting him to behave more like a real one...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Fortunately, I have tomorrow...or rather, today...off.
I can get some sleep, wake up and take Robo-Dog to the park.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If I want to learn how to make him behave like a real dog, then I should go see some.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For now, I should go to sleep...
